crossRefs.note: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Oboth
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped during the Exodus

translations.web: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.
translations.bsb: They journeyed from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim in the wilderness opposite Moab to the east.
translations.kjv: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
